cohort: Women who underwent laparoscopic tubal ligation at Silchar Medical College, Silchar, Assam, India between July 1, 2017, and June 30, 2018, excluding those who underwent tubectomy during caesarean section.
finding: There was a long interval between last childbirth and tubal ligation, and the majority of women underwent medical termination of pregnancy at the time of sterilization.
